subject: Upcoming Company Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce the upcoming company team building event scheduled for next month. The event will include various team-building activities, followed by a casual dinner. This is a great opportunity for all of us to bond outside of work and strengthen our teamwork. More details regarding the event agenda and logistics will be shared soon. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for further updates. Looking forward to a fun and productive event together! Best regards, [Your Name]
